page.overview:
Who is Jean Pierre Polnareff?

OVA:Other Media [http://www.imdb.com/name/nm0850757/ Tsutomu Tareki] [http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=35085 Akira Negishi]

OVA[http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=14626 Mark Atherlay] [http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=29999 Jérôme Pauwels] [http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=26386 Riccardo Lombardo]

In Stardust Crusaders, the Frenchman Polnareff travels with Jotaro and Joseph to avenge his sister, who was murdered by a man with two right hands. In Vento Aureo, Polnareff reappears to aid the rebellious Team Bucciarati in their quest to defeat the Boss of Italian gang Passione.

Polnareff is a Stand User and wields Silver Chariot.

Also known as: Polnareff.
